resources.string: Records the payments your bank\'s app announces, into the account you choose for it.
Cents reads the notifications of the apps chosen below and records each payment or income without a category, waiting under To categorize. Nothing leaves the phone.
Android lets Cents read notifications. It can be taken back from the same system screen.
Android has to let Cents read notifications before anything is recorded. Turn Cents on in that list, then come back.

Each app has its own account and its own words. A notification from it with an income word is an income, one with an expense word is an expense; with neither, or with no amount, it is ignored. The same amount twice within a minute is recorded once.
Its account is gone, so nothing is recorded

A notification needs an income or expense word and one amount with a currency, such as € or EUR. Masked numbers and ambiguous amounts are ignored. Captures with the same amount, currency and direction within a minute are counted once.
Only apps with an icon on the home screen are listed. Apps already chosen are not.
Which account do its payments go into?
Tap a word to remove it. Case and accents do not matter, and only whole words match: “cargo” does not match “encargo”.
No words, so nothing is recorded as an expense.
No words, so nothing is recorded as an income.
This list is replaced by the one Cents came with. Words you added are dropped.
A notification with it no longer counts as an expense.
A notification with it no longer counts as an income.
Its payments are no longer recorded. What it already recorded stays in the list.
What the app says when money goes out
What the app says when money comes in

Show the amount and account after a movement is recorded. A payment is only recognised as a subscription\'s charge while these are on, because that notice comes with Undo. Ignored and duplicate notifications stay silent.
Confirmations after an income or expense is recorded from a notification.
%1$s · %2$s. Nothing added: the subscription already counts it.
A payment was matched to a subscription.
An amount right after one is not the payment
An amount is skipped when one of these is among the few words before it, in the same sentence: in “Saldo disponible: 1.502,10 €” that is a balance, not a payment. Tap a word to remove it.
No words, so a balance beside a payment makes both ignored.
An amount after it can be taken as the payment again.
What an app starts with when it is chosen
Paste one and see what would be recorded
No app is chosen yet, so the starting words read it.
Nothing is saved. It is read exactly the way capture reads a real notification.
Ignored: no expense or income word
Ignored: no amount with a currency
Saved without a category, waiting under To categorize.
The amount is in %1$s and the account is in %2$s. There is no conversion, so it is ignored.
Add the word this bank uses to the app’s expense or income words.
Only an amount written with its currency counts, such as 23,40 € or EUR 23. Masked numbers like ****7146 never do.
Which one is the payment is not guessed. Add the word in front of the one that is not, such as “saldo”, to the ignore words.
Ignored: the app\'s account is archived
The text reads fine. Switch capture on in Capture for a notification like this to be recorded.
The text reads fine with the starting words, but nothing is read until the app it comes from is chosen in Capture.
The text reads fine, but this app\'s account is archived or gone. Choose another account for it in Capture.
